pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.75-$1.00 per click (median $0.87), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.55-$0.76 (median $0.64); bidding $0.48 wins ~7% of page views, paying ~$0.44 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
